name: helm-values-identity
description: Extract service identity from Helm chart values.yaml files (Example-style .example/ directory)

extractions.name: helm_service_identity
extractions.description: Extract service name, DNS, IAM role, and resource identifiers from Helm values
extractions.prompt_hint: These are Helm chart values files for a Kubernetes-deployed service. Extract: the service name (from iamRole, app name, or metadata), DNS aliases (from ingress.hosts or service names), IAM role (from iamRole or annotations), database connection strings (from env vars like DATABASE_URL or spring.datasource.url), and queue identifiers (from env vars like SQS_QUEUE_URL or queue config).
